notes.title: 【Update Notice】Ver1.1.5
notes.notes:
1.Optimized game performance.
2.Enhanced compatibility with the Steam Deck, and added graphical buttons and key mappings in some interfaces for easier operation.
3.Fixed some issues on macOS and improved smoothness to some extent.
4.Adjusted the unlock sequence of certain character stories.

notes.title: 【Update Notice】Ver1.1.3
notes.notes:
1.Further optimize the display logic of the "Branch Management" interface to improve smoothness.
2.Fixed the issue where the mouse would sometimes be restricted in the window while in the Main Interface of Pub.
3.Corrected some textual description errors.

notes.title: 【Update Notice】Ver1.1.2
notes.notes:
1.Added save protection to prevent abnormal saves caused by unexpected interruptions during saving.
2.Properly adjusted the font color and size of the ordering prompt to make it more prominent.
3.Optimized the position where coins appear during pub management to prevent them from obscuring the screen.
4.Corrected errors in some localized texts.
5.Now, dialogue will stop auto-playing when opening the option panel.
6.Adjusted the base volume of some background music.
7.Fixed the issue where Sharleely's bracelet was not displayed correctly in some dialogues.
8.Fixed the issue where subtitles would repeat in some H-scenes.
9.Fixed the issue where the unlock sequence for some H-scenes was incorrect.

notes.title: 【Update Notice】Ver1.1.1

3.Corrected some text display errors.

notes.title: 【Important Update】Ver1.1.0
notes.notes:
After a period of effort and exploration, we have made a relatively significant update in version 1.1.0.

We have added two high-resolution options "2560*1440" and "3840*2160" to the game. We have also made more delicate display optimizations and anti-aliasing for illustrations and Live2D animations.
Now, players using high-resolution screens can finally see clearer details of the characters.

Note: If you encounter display issues when switching resolutions, you can try switching back to a lower resolution windowed mode for gameplay. 
Due to the underlying code has undergone major changes this time, if you encounter any problems, you are very welcome to report them to us in the community or our DC group, we will fix them promptly.

In addition, we have made the following changes:
1.Added a "Return to Main Menu" button for Shiu's mini-game.
2.The volume of the ending animation is now automatically adjusted in relation to the "voice volume."
3.Fixed an issue where right-clicking during viewing of gallery details would close the gallery panel along with it.
4.Now you can switch the outfits of some characters in the 'Training' interface.

We are welcome everyone to update to the new version for the best gaming experience!
https://discord.gg/kceQnK3yzq
